My other huge concern was she once again parroted her line of "If you're too dangerous to be allowed to fly, you're too dangerous to own a gun."

First of all, flying is NOT a Constitutional right. To keep and bear arms is. But more worrying, is the fact that a no-fly list is completely arbitrary, and one can end up on it for any number of reasons. And there is no day in court to decide if you go on the list, either. There is absolutely NO due process of law in putting someone on it.

The Fifth and Fourteenth Amendments both specifically lay out that no individual shall be deprived of life, liberty, or property without the due process of law. The Fifth Amendment states that it shall not happen to any person, and the Fourteenth Amendment states that no state shall cause it to happen.

The Second Amendment guarantees the right to keep and bear arms. To deprive someone of a right, is to deprive them of part of their liberty. So if you ban someone from owning a gun based upon a list, you are depriving them of a liberty guaranteed by the Constitution.

To boil it down, banning gun ownership based on a no-fly list is a blatant violation of the Second, Fifth, and Fourteenth Amendments. That means if such a law were passed it would be completely, totally, 100% ILLEGAL and UNCONSTITUTIONAL. And any lawmaker that voted for it or any court that upheld it, would be guilty of violating their oath to uphold and defend the Constitution of the United States.

tl;dr - Hillary would declare an illegal no-fly zone and possibly go to war over it. And despite her claims of "defending the Second Amendment", she has proven with her own words that she would effectively destroy it.
